pass_run.method: Automated largest-first pass (mutpass.sh): per unit build2 + pick_multi.py (first flippable 16-bit Thumb b<cond> per fn) + mutrun.sh; on a behavior-neutral (dead) first site, advance to next fn's branch (MAXTRY=4). A unit is a TRUE survivor only if all candidates survive. Stops on first true survivor per instruction. Condition-flip = XOR 0x0100 on the cond nibble (beq<->bne, bcs<->bcc, bmi<->bpl, bhi<->bls, bge<->blt, bgt<->ble).

gxsvc_investigation.verdict: SURVIVOR EXPLAINED - fuzz-coverage gap in the gxsvc stub model; NOT a harness equivalence blind spot and NOT a C defect.
gxsvc_investigation.structure: Each wrapper (SVC_SwitchBFMode/SwitchWakeupMode/SetMicGain/CodecMicDelay1Bit): response=0; status=GX8002_<cmd>(&response,200); if(status==0 && response==EXPECTED){LOG_ok;return 0;} LOG_fail; return status;
gxsvc_investigation.root_cause: The GX8002_<cmd> transport is a harness STUB that returns a pseudo-random NONZERO status and does not write the success 'response'. Compiled as 'cbnz status -> fail' (dominating) then 'cmp response,EXPECTED; b<cond> fail'. With status always != 0, the cbnz always routes to the fail path BEFORE the second-condition branch, so the success half of every wrapper is never exercised. Flipping the (second-condition) branch - or even the cbnz - is behavior-neutral because response is 0 != EXPECTED too. The only reachable path is the straight-line fail/error path, which has no post-call decision whose single-site flip changes the observable (return=status + fail LOG).
gxsvc_investigation.equivalence_impact: The v0-stock-vs-v1-C equivalence for gxsvc is verified on the fail/error path (all 48 baseline tests pass). The SUCCESS path (status==0 && response==EXPECTED) is UNVERIFIED under the current stub model.
gxsvc_investigation.not_a_c_change: No driver C change implied; the C matches stock on every exercised input.
gxsvc_investigation.recommended_followup: Add a stub override so GX8002_SwitchBFMode/SwitchWakeupMode/SetMicGain/CodecMicDelay1Bit return status==0 and write response=EXPECTED for a subset of fuzz seeds (analogous to the u64/d2ulz harness extension). That exercises the success path, verifies stock==C there, and makes a success-path branch flip catchable. Deferred (no C change, past this turn's time box).

gxsvc_stub_override.change: Added K_SVCRESP kind (hw.h/harness.c/autogen). ~half seeds (g_seed even): GX8002_<cmd> stub returns status=0 and writes response=EXPECTED, identical v0/v1. fixed_ret=expected|(ptr_idx<<8)|((w-1)<<9).
gxsvc_stub_override.baseline: 48/48 with success tuple executed -> success-path equivalence VERIFIED (stock==C)
gxsvc_stub_override.mutant: still survives; ROOT CAUSE: SVC wrappers return (status==0 && resp==EXPECTED)?0:status, and success requires status==0, so fail path returns status==0 exactly when success returns 0 -> return value is branch-independent by contract. Only diff is audio logging (audio_log_flags @0x43d0ce = *(u8*)0x20004543, device-gated OFF, sink not in equivalence surface). NOT a blind spot, NOT a defect.
